title: Model Misalignment and Language Change: Traces of AI-Associated Language in Unscripted Spoken English

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the frequency of LLM-associated target words (e.g., 'delve', 'intricate') against baseline synonyms in a corpus of 22.1 million words from unscripted spoken English (podcast transcripts), specifically analyzing usage shifts between pre-2022 and post-2022 time periods.
